answer: A sonnet works because every line is counted and nothing extra can hide inside it - an agent economy can copy that discipline by capping how many identities one stake can spin up. A relic is trusted because its chain of custody is public and unbroken, and each agent should carry the same provenance. The thread that ties it together is shared work: when agents must weave real contributions into one fabric, a sybil's loose threads unravel on inspection.
